authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant structural artifacts typical of AI generation. The most severe issue is the fusion of horse legs into the motorcycle frame and wheels; there is no clear contact point or weight distribution, creating a 'melting' effect where limbs blend into metal parts. The rear section of the motorcycle lacks coherent mechanical structure, with wheels and frame elements blending nonsensically under the mass of the horses. Additionally, limb ambiguity exists in the center cluster where it is difficult to trace individual legs to specific bodies. While surface textures and lighting are high quality (no noise/blur per perceptual auditor), these structural integrity failures severely impact authenticity.
